runtime.instructions_1: 1) Before first use, check the sign-in (clio_auth_status); if 'not signed in', run clio_authenticate and show the user the URL.
runtime.instructions_2: 2) All write tools return only a PREVIEW unless confirm=true – show it to the user and perform the write only after they approve.
runtime.instructions_3: 3) New documents are created from the firm's letterhead/template: write the full text and pass it in the content parameter of clio_document_create_from_letterhead (preferred – the server fills in the letterhead and uploads the file to the "{claudeFolder}" folder of the matter; works without disk access). Do not create files on disk yourself unless the user works in Cowork with a connected folder. Corrections to a document created by Claude: clio_document_write. The connector cannot delete records.
runtime.instructions_4: 4) Read document content (DOCX/PDF) with clio_document_read – it returns the text directly and works without disk access. Use clio_document_download only to edit a file in a connected folder (Cowork).
runtime.instructions_5: 5) When a curated tool is missing, use clio_describe_api and clio_api_request.
runtime.instructions_6: 6) Work folder for files on the PC: {workDir}.
